title: Unit Event — Knowing the Unseen — Episode5 I Have to Look Deeper

meta.Episode: Episode5 — I Have to Look Deeper
meta.Event Outline: Ena debates whether she should aim for art school post-graduation. With this inner turmoil comes restlessness, which begins to affect her art. Mr. Yukihira notices that she's struggling, and after she divulges the cause, he invites her to take part in an excursion.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: How are things coming along on your end, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
I've got everything set up here.
I just need to clean, and then I'll be done.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
I see.
So, what can you tell me about this painting?

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: Were you able to learn anything from your father's work?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Um, I'm sorry.
I didn't pay much attention to it while setting it up.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: In that case, let's examine it together.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
This painting...
Can you tell me what it's about?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's titled “A Peony Blooming in the Night”...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: If I recall, the night I was born, he saw a single peony blooming on his way home from the hospital. So, he decided to draw it.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: What you just told me is simply the backstory.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
That is not what I'm talking about.
I was asking what you felt after seeing this painting.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line:
Yes.
I'd like for you to think about what you feel as you look at each of these paintings with your own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: To see what they're really about.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I will take care of the rest of your duties.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I honestly don't want to go around looking at his stuff...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Because each one is a reminder of how far I am from his caliber.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But if this is what Mr. Yukihira wants me to do, then I might be able to find whatever it is that I've been missing...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(I have to do this.
I have to take a hard look at his art...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Sorry, Len, Rin. I know you guys are worried about me.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But I'm gonna go around to look.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <B-But... Don't push yourself too hard, okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Anyway, I'm thinking about starting from the beginning, so let's go over there.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (All of his paintings are overwhelmingly good...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (The framing and even the application of the colors are innovative...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <This painting of a river at night... It feels so strange and surreal. Almost like something out of a dream...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, yeah. The river in this painting's actually right near my house.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, unlike how it's depicted, it's actually a pretty ordinary place. I tried painting it one time, but it didn't turn out very well.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And yet, with him, it turns into this...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Also, I know I'm supposed to see how it makes me feel, but I really don't know.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I understand all the technical aspects behind it, like how he's framed the river in a way to make it look bigger...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But it feels kinda dark for some reason...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah, a lot of them seem to take place at night...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm guessing it's because the theme of this exhibit is “Deep in the Night”. Hence all these night paintings.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, it's just... I think when he drew these plays a big role in terms of what sort of impression they give off.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The paintings at the beginning take place at night, but they seem to focus more on a source of light, like the moon or the streetlamps.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So, they didn't feel that dark.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But the ones on this wall...
The pieces in this period don't give off the same impression.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hmm... How do I put it...?
I can't place my finger on it, but they feel a lot darker for some reason.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <A dark room with empty cans and paint everywhere...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<That's a canvas, right...?
It's on the ground for whatever reason...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I remember seeing this one when I was little...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah. He had it in his studio.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But he sorta leered at me when I saw it, and immediately put it away afterwards...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I guess he didn't want you to see it.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Come to think of it, this painting...
His brush strokes look a lot rougher.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: His style had always been pretty rough. I mean, you can basically see each brush stroke...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
But this painting...
This goes beyond that. It's like he was all over the place.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Was he feeling pressured? Maybe he was in pain or something...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, like nothing mattered to him anymore.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But he felt that he needed to keep painting...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I have to draw something... Anything!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I lose my ability to draw, then I'd really...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Why am I so bad at this...?!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I drew stuff in the same way back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (After he told me I should give up on my dream, I drew and drew as much as I could... But I wasn't able to produce anything good. I was in a state of panic. I didn't know what to do...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(His painting turned out better...
But I felt the chaos I'm seeing here...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <What if your dad was having trouble painting, Ena?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Still, I am sensing pain in this picture.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm jealous of how he can paint like this...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(So, what made him draw this...?
Something that looks like pain and suffering...)

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: I'd like for you to think about what you feel as you look at each of these paintings with your own eyes.

rows.Speaker: Yukihira
rows.Line: To see what they're really about.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I don't know. I can't say for sure...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (But I have to look at it and see how I feel minus all assumptions or extraneous information.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Then, I might be able to find the answer...)
